The supplier’s added attribution of inherited AC through affine quasi-coherent equivalence changes neither that identity nor the sufficiency of the stated AC hypothesis.

AC is already assumed in the Statement, and F14 explicitly includes symmetric-algebra constructions among inherited uses, so the supplier’s refined AC accounting invalidates no clause.
